lines.text: AUGUR-7 DEEPCORE RIG — DOMINION EXTRACTION PERMIT 7-K
Ah. You must be the Handler Mara sent. Hi. Dexter Mane. I'd shake your hand, but there's a scale-state in the way.
That rig is licensed, insured and very expensive. The foundation fails with or without it. I'm making sure the Thoughtstone doesn't fail with it.
I'm the reason it's being measured. Different thing.
His futures are sharp. Every one of them has a version where he's sorry. None of them has a version where he stops.
...That's unsettlingly fair. Do try not to break my drill more than necessary.
